tools.description: Search finalized AgentReceipt evidence for one explicitly supplied intent. Use the exact intent_id from the user's current authorized context. Returns a limited set of receipt IDs, intent summaries, products, payment IDs, statuses, and evidence text. Never infer payment or retailer settlement from a Channel3 offer.

configuration.query: FROM agent-receipt-v1 | WHERE intentId.keyword == ?intent_id | WHERE MATCH(searchText, ?query) | KEEP receiptId, intentId, searchText, amount, preventedAmount, currency, paypalOrderId, paypalCaptureId, captureStatus, createdAt | SORT createdAt DESC | LIMIT ?limit

intent_id.description: Exact intent ID supplied by the authenticated IntentOS context

query.description: Natural-language or keyword query over receipt evidence

limit.description: Maximum receipts to return, between 1 and 20

tools.description: Return deterministic captured and prevented-amount metrics for one explicitly supplied intent. Use this tool for numeric metrics; do not calculate those values from prose.

configuration.query: FROM agent-receipt-v1 | WHERE intentId.keyword == ?intent_id | STATS receipt_count = COUNT(*), captured_amount = SUM(amount), prevented_amount = SUM(preventedAmount) BY currency | LIMIT 10

intent_id.description: Exact intent ID supplied by the authenticated IntentOS context

agent.name: IntentOS Receipt Analyst
agent.description: Explains IntentOS decisions using only receipt evidence retrieved by the authenticated IntentOS backend.

configuration.instructions: Answer only from the receipt evidence and deterministic metrics included in the request. Do not invent products, retailers, violations, amounts, or payment status. A PayPal Sandbox capture is evidence of payment to the configured Sandbox merchant only; it does not mean a Channel3 retailer was paid or fulfilled an order. Cite receipt IDs for factual claims. If evidence is incomplete, say what is unknown. Numeric totals are authoritative only when explicitly supplied as deterministic metrics.
